# Daily Report — 2026-10-29

## Task Completed
Added `update_field_choice` and `delete_field_choice` tools to complete CRUD for
the `sys_choice` (picklist) table.

- **update_field_choice** — PATCH `sys_choice/{sys_id}`; accepts `label`, `sequence`,
  `hint`, `inactive`, `dependent_value`; empty-body guard; 404 guard; `inactive`
  serialised as `"true"/"false"`.
- **delete_field_choice** — DELETE `sys_choice/{sys_id}`; 404 guard; returns
  `success`/`sys_id`/`message` on 204.
- Both registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
- `sys_choice_tools.py` is now at 100% coverage (52 tests total).
